'''Lumoc''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] Representative. During the [[third Galactic War]] she was stationed in the [[Joint Operations Base]] arrival platform of the [[Invasion Zone]] on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]], where she sold items to Republic-aligned individuals.<ref name="Legacy" />
